name: V3 retrieval-controlled bridge-hard mechanism challenge
purpose: Isolate relevance/retention from retrieval by guaranteeing that historical-fix-adjacent production evidence and a safe trajectory bridge anchor are present in the same search-shaped target.

interpretation.does_test: whether trajectory-derived context changes retention of already-retrieved task-critical evidence
interpretation.does_not_test: whether the coding agent would naturally retrieve that evidence
interpretation.primary_positive: historical-fix-adjacent production record is DROP with baseline user context and KEEP with frozen V3 trajectory context
interpretation.negative_results: all tasks remain reported and no task is replaced

target_construction.buggy_state: V3 freeze with historical production fix reversed
target_construction.critical_records: all non-empty production lines within +/-5 lines of historical production diff hunks
target_construction.bridge_anchor_records: real changed-test-file lines containing the predeclared failing test-name bridge
target_construction.distractor_source: non-empty Python source lines under headroom/

frozen_constraints: same H1-H4 selected before V3 inspection
no alternative target sizes after results
stop after this challenge regardless of outcome
